scope: Enhanced (physically based) renderer: material manifest, generated normal maps, static-light grid and PBR fragment shaders; no game, engine or renderer code imported

retail_evidence.purpose: DTX catalogue (3825 textures) measured by surface.retail to write and check config/materials.json rules.

2026-10-21: texture names for the emissive rules (fn* neon signs, flolite/smallight/baselite/amberlight lights, monitors, tvbig, exit signs): 54 world textures, the lightbulb1/2, neonmartini and tvbig model skins and 25 monitor sprite frames resolve to an emissive class (surface.retail).

design_references.purpose: Inspiration for named material classes; its patterns match no retail path and its single-star matcher is not reproduced.

The donor's lava/hazard words, adopted as the textures/ hazard rules (emission instead of the donor's specular imitation of glow; slime keeps the wet class). Retail matches one texture, textures/blueyellow/toxic.dtx.
